title: Sources: SoftBank is seeking to raise up to $100B from Gulf investors for a fund to buy companies and improve their operations with AI and other advanced tech (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: SoftBank is seeking to raise up to $100B from Gulf investors for a fund to buy companies and improve their operations with AI and other advanced tech — Founder and chief executive Masayoshi Son has held talks with senior figures in the UAE in recent weeks
